name: Bloodline of the Elite: Combat Insight

system.description: You gain amazing combat senses with or without your Byakugan. As a bonus action, while observing a creature, you can make an Identify (Ninjutsu, Genjutsu or Taijutsu/Bukijutsu, pick one) check against a creature you can see, vs their Level DC. On a success, you are able to learn of any one special action or ability they have that would qualify as or is similar to, the associated check.
